recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not reintroduce the obsolete procedureCode/procedureReference split in current core. If procedure-code searching is desired for the current design, it should be raised as a new current-version Imaging Integration decision.
issue_request: FHIR-12189 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to clarify ImagingStudy.procedure by renaming the original procedure element to procedureReference, adding procedureCode CodeableConcept with ProcedureCodeSequence as an alternate name and an example LOINC/RSNA Radiology Playbook binding, and adding a procedureCode search parameter with a note that Procedure.code is not searched.
initial_application: Commit d6c6d61a72 explicitly referenced GF#12189 and changed the historical ImagingStudy spreadsheet from procedure to procedureReference while adding procedureCode with ImagingProcedureCode binding metadata. This shows the DSTU2 request was initially applied before the old spreadsheet source was replaced by current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: Later final issues changed the representation introduced by FHIR-12189. FHIR-17427 clarified old procedureReference wording, FHIR-19637 replaced procedureCode/procedureReference with repeating procedure content, FHIR-20166 updated the ImagingProcedureCode binding target, and FHIR-53025 establishes the current R6 design where ImagingStudy.procedure is a repeating Reference(Procedure). Current fhir.ini mappings record the historical merge of procedureCode/procedureReference into procedure.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current active StructureDefinition defines ImagingStudy.procedure as 0..* Reference(Procedure), the active procedure search parameter points at ImagingStudy.procedure, and no active ImagingStudy.procedureCode or ImagingStudy.procedureReference element remains in the ImagingStudy source.
